# Gerris Corp

> Chris Abraham's consultancy: fractional technical leadership, developer specs and QA, AI tools built with OpenAI Codex and Claude Code, project rescue, technical SEO, site speed, migrations, AI search visibility, and reputation management. Run by Chris Abraham in Arlington, Virginia. Chris has built websites since 1994; Gerris Corp was founded in 2012.

Every engagement starts with a conversation. Contact: chris@gerriscorp.com, +1 202-352-5051, https://calendly.com/chrisabraham/30, or https://www.upwork.com/freelancers/chrisjabraham. Each link below goes to the Markdown version of a page; the HTML version is the same URL without index.md.

## Consulting and technical direction

- [Fractional technical lead](https://gerriscorp.com/services/technical-lead/index.md): Chris Abraham owns your web stack part time: diagnoses problems, writes specs, directs developers and vendors, ships fixes, and reports in plain English.
- [Developer specs and implementation QA](https://gerriscorp.com/services/developers/index.md): Chris Abraham turns a diagnosis into a prioritized developer spec with evidence and acceptance criteria, then verifies on the live site that the fix shipped.
- [Agency partner and white-label support](https://gerriscorp.com/services/agency-partner/index.md): Chris Abraham works inside agencies' client relationships as a technical SEO and AI search specialist, under NDA, in your Basecamp, with your branding.
- [Project rescue, takeovers, and legacy migrations](https://gerriscorp.com/services/rescue/index.md): Chris Abraham takes over stalled or inherited web projects: inventories code, servers, accounts, and DNS, stabilizes them, and moves sites off dead software.
- [AI agents and automation, built safely](https://gerriscorp.com/services/ai-automation/index.md): Chris Abraham builds AI tools with OpenAI Codex and Claude Code: reviewed actions, tests, secrets outside Git, and backups with a tested restore path.
- [Data cleanup and AI-output audits](https://gerriscorp.com/services/data-cleanup/index.md): Chris Abraham cleans and dedupes contact lists and CRMs with Python, and audits AI-generated spreadsheets for fabricated or wrong data before you rely on them.
- [Analytics and measurement you can trust](https://gerriscorp.com/services/analytics/index.md): Chris Abraham audits GA4 and Search Console data, removes ghost traffic, fixes conversion tracking, and explains what your numbers can and can't actually prove.
- [AI use policy and staff training](https://gerriscorp.com/services/ai-policy/index.md): Chris Abraham learns how your staff already use AI, writes a two-page policy they will follow, picks the approved tools, and trains the team with real examples.
- [Strategic advisory and briefings](https://gerriscorp.com/services/advisory/index.md): Chris Abraham advises founders and executives on AI, search, reputation, and technology, and writes second opinions on rebuilds, migrations, and vendor plans.
- [AI workflow testing and acceptance reviews](https://gerriscorp.com/services/ai-workflow-testing/index.md): Test an AI pilot against real tasks before expanding it. Chris Abraham checks outputs, permissions, failure handling, and evidence with a repeatable test set.
- [B2B catalog SEO for manufacturers and distributors](https://gerriscorp.com/services/b2b-catalog-seo/index.md): B2B catalog SEO for manufacturers and distributors: product specifications, part discovery, crawlable templates, and quote paths tested on a focused pilot.

- [Programmatic site: managing crawling and indexing at scale](https://gerriscorp.com/case-studies/programmatic-indexing/index.md): A trading card price site of 20,000+ pages on an expired domain lost indexing after a strong start. How Chris Abraham manages crawling at scale.
- [Health-testing store: recovering after an SEO plugin outage](https://gerriscorp.com/case-studies/indexing-recovery/index.md): A WooCommerce health testing store lost indexing, traffic, and AI referrals after its SEO plugin was briefly disabled: how the recovery was checked.
- [Multi-location brand: untangling the parent from its first location](https://gerriscorp.com/case-studies/multi-location-entity/index.md): A custom closets brand with locations in several states and one website: Chris Abraham separated the parent brand from its first location in schema.
- [Seasonal retailer: a staged plan around the peak](https://gerriscorp.com/case-studies/seasonal-retailer/index.md): A multi store seasonal retailer with related sites and profiles: audit findings and a staged plan that keeps risky changes away from the peak season.
- [Therapy practice: a suspended Google Business Profile reinstated](https://gerriscorp.com/case-studies/gbp-reinstatement/index.md): A hypnotherapy practice's suspended Google Business Profile, reinstated in February 2025 after Chris Abraham reviewed the listing and built a documented appeal.
- [Two B2B companies on Umbraco: publishing and technical operations](https://gerriscorp.com/case-studies/umbraco-operations/index.md): Two B2B companies on Umbraco: 54 city landing pages and steady publishing for one, and a homepage overhaul with cache and template fixes for the other.
- [AI company: search visibility for recruiting engineers](https://gerriscorp.com/case-studies/ai-recruiting/index.md): An AI company recruiting engineers in the Bay Area wanted to appear in AI answers about jobs. Chris Abraham audited its footprint and planned the fix.
- [Contact data: three cleanups and an AI audit](https://gerriscorp.com/case-studies/data-cleanup/index.md): Python pipelines that cleaned an 88,900 contact list, merged two 28,800 record exports at 94% email coverage, and caught an AI tracker inventing its data.
- [A founder's public record: tracing AI errors to the pages behind them](https://gerriscorp.com/case-studies/founder-record/index.md): AI answers about me got a founding year wrong, invented a company rename, and doubted a real award. Each traced to a page, and the archive settled the rest.
- [Four static sites: a speed and AI crawler pass in one afternoon](https://gerriscorp.com/case-studies/four-site-speed-pass/index.md): Four static sites I own, measured with mobile Lighthouse, fixed in one afternoon, and measured again: analytics deferred, images resized, robots rules verified.
